title: PR #2 — Scaffold Worker, bindings, migrations tooling, and verify gates
description: Create the single Worker application that serves both UI and API, wire Cloudflare bindings and typed secrets, establish forward-only D1 migrations, and put the lint/format/typecheck/CI gates in place so every later PR is verifiable. Requirement IDs: TASK-2, TASK-3, TASK-4, TASK-59.
acceptanceCriteria: Project uses React Router v8 framework mode with SSR and the Cloudflare Vite plugin
Route modules live only in `app/routes/`; page UI is never added to a route module, matching the feature layout in AGENTS.md
`pnpm dev` serves the app in the Workers runtime, and `pnpm build` exits 0
`wrangler.jsonc` declares DB (D1), KV_SESSIONS (KV), and RATE_LIMITER (rate limiting); no R2 binding until R2 is enabled on the account
A loader reads the D1 binding via `context.get(cloudflareContext)` and successfully runs `SELECT 1`
A missing required secret produces a generic 500 and never leaks the secret name to the client
No secret appears in the client bundle
`pnpm db:migrate:local`, `pnpm db:migrate:remote`, and a local reset script work
`pnpm typecheck` runs `tsc --noEmit` in strict mode and fails on a type error
`pnpm lint` and `pnpm format:check` pass on a clean checkout and fail on a seeded violation
A GitHub Actions workflow runs install, typecheck, lint, unit tests, and build on pull requests
`packageManager` is pinned in `package.json` and the Node version is pinned in `.nvmrc`

steps.details: Run `npx create-cloudflare@latest -- . --framework=react-router` (or scaffold into a temp directory and move contents if the CLI refuses a non-empty directory, preserving `.agent/`, AGENTS.md, and dotfiles from PR #1). Keep SSR enabled in `react-router.config.ts`. Confirm the tree matches: `app/routes`, `app/root.tsx`, `app/routes.ts`, `workers/app.ts`, `vite.config.ts`, `wrangler.jsonc`.

Edit `wrangler.jsonc`: keep `main`, `compatibility_flags: ["nodejs_compat"]`, `observability.enabled`, and `upload_source_maps`. Add a `d1_databases` binding DB with the id from PR #1, a `kv_namespaces` binding KV_SESSIONS, and a top-level `ratelimits` entry named RATE_LIMITER with namespace_id 1001 and a 60-per-60s simple limit. Do not add an R2 binding until R2 is enabled on the account.

steps.description: Add typed environment and secret accessor
steps.details: Create `app/lib/.server/env.ts` exporting `AppSecrets`, `ServerConfigError`, and `requireSecret(env, name)` that throws when a secret is empty. Create `app/lib/.server/context.ts` with a React Router `createContext<CloudflareContext>()` key. Loaders read bindings with `context.get(cloudflareContext)`. Never import these modules from client code.

Create `migrations/` with a comment-only `0001_noop.sql`. Add scripts: `db:migrate:local` → `wrangler d1 migrations apply bridgewarden-db --local`, `db:migrate:remote` → `--remote`, `db:reset:local` → remove the local D1 state then re-apply.

Add TypeScript strict mode, ESLint (with React hooks and import rules) or Biome, and Prettier. Add scripts `typecheck`, `lint`, `lint:fix`, `format`, `format:check`. Add `.nvmrc` with the Node major version and a `packageManager` field pinned to the installed pnpm version. Ensure `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check` passes on the scaffold.

Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml` triggered on `pull_request` and `push` to `main`: checkout, setup Node from `.nvmrc`, setup pnpm with cache, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`. Do not deploy from CI in this PR.

Confirm `.dev.vars` from PR #1 is present with placeholder names and that `.gitignore` covers `.env.local`, `.dev.vars`, `.wrangler/`, and `build/`. Add a README note that real values are filled manually.

steps.description: Add a health route that proves bindings work
steps.details: Create `app/routes/health.tsx` with a loader that reads the D1 binding via `context.get(cloudflareContext)`, runs `SELECT 1 AS ok`, and returns JSON. Do not expose binding names or secret values. Add a Vitest test using `@cloudflare/vitest-plugin` that asserts 200 and a generic shape.

Run `pnpm dev`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, and `pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run`. Seed a deliberate type error, a lint violation, and a failing test one at a time; confirm each gate exits non-zero; revert. Grep `build/client` for every secret value to confirm none leaked.

technicalNotes: React Router v8 with the Cloudflare Vite plugin does not support SPA mode or prerendering; keep SSR.
Bindings are available at `context.cloudflare.env` inside loaders/actions.
Do not create a monorepo; the extension and Android app will be separate projects that reuse the documented contract.
Use pnpm and Node 24, matching the local toolchain.
The scaffold step must preserve PR #1 artifacts (.agent/, AGENTS.md, .gitignore, .editorconfig). Scaffold into a temp directory if necessary rather than deleting them.
CI must not require Cloudflare credentials in this PR.
R2 is not enabled on the account, so the binding is intentionally absent; attachments remain phase 2.
The local shell exports NODE_ENV=production; `pnpm dev` forces NODE_ENV=development to avoid a dev-only `_jsxDEV is not a function` crash.
Use `@cloudflare/vitest-plugin`; `@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers` is deprecated and pinned to Vitest 4.
The Cloudflare Vite plugin copies `.dev.vars` into `build/server`; the deploy script deletes it before upload.

pullRequest.scope: Project scaffold, wrangler config, typed env, migration tooling, lint/format/typecheck, CI workflow, health route, gitignore.
pullRequest.outOfScope: Design system, real schema tables, auth, vault features.
